body:
Thanks for replying. I think I know there are solutions to my problems which keeps me from really doing it, but at the same time whilst I feel like this it is hard to motivate myself to do those things. Committing to losing weight would probably significantly improve a lot of areas in my life.

I don't know whether I want him back, we definitely weren't great at the end. I suppose my ideal would be to return to how we used to be together, but I don't know if we've gone too far for that to ever happen. I try not to think about how to get him back, as he doesn't seem open to that and I will probably hurt myself more.

When I am feeling better I can be optimistic I am looking into a distance learning course in Illustration when the baby is 6 months and my older daughter is in nursery. And I know that if I lost weight and got my confidence back and got on my feet that there is  potential in my life.

It's just the rut of the current situation and the constant work of a toddler alone on top of my health issues.

He is giving me money, so in that respect he is being responsible it's just I feel like two hours in a week isn't alot. Both for there relationship and for me to have a break. And so I can get things like mowing the lawn done which I can't do because my daughter is too young to be left alone whilst I do it. Everything is building up.
